hook.text: You could wash all your clothes, then dry them all, then fold them all. Or wash-dry-fold one load at a time.

buildup.text: Batch processing groups work together. Flow processing moves one piece continuously through each step.

discovery.text: Batching feels efficient but hides delays. The first item waits until the whole batch finishes.

twist.text: Flow exposes problems immediately. If one step breaks, you know within minutes, not days.

climax.text: Toyota switched from batch to flow and cut production time from weeks to hours.

punchline.text: Batch hides problems. Flow reveals them.

quiz.question: What did Toyota achieve by switching from batch to flow production?
options: Production time cut from weeks to hours
